_about: The shared kit's numbers, the same in every mode.

levels._about: What a level means everywhere. count: how many levels there are; every list below has one entry a level (check step 1). decoys: things on offer nobody asked for. lookalike: one decoy looks like a wanted thing. hintS: seconds without a right move before help comes, counted from the step's start (Zafar, 19 Nov: 7, 8, 9, 10; was old chai's 7, 9, 11, 13), the clock standing still only while the step's own first light is still to come, so help never lands on that light. mistakes (the kit's rule, js/shared/kit/mistakes.rules.js, the kitchen applying it): whether a pan the child may fill (the chosen one, not yet poured, not boiling over) takes a wrong thing or a wrong amount; where it does not, the thing is refused with the wiggle and Nani's "no" (lines.no); mostOfOne: where it does, the most spoonfuls of any one counted thing, while water, milk and the tea go in once each (the standard's principle 6, every game's rule, Zafar, 19 Nov; it replaces old chai's caps, sugar at the number asked and the asked spice at one, SH-38). cardEnglish, cardPicture: whether the order card shows them or hides them behind a tap. dishCard: the dish's own card pops as the dish's word is said in the headline. wordAtTap: a thing's word is said as it goes in. countAloud, countAsWords: counting is said, and shown as number words (else dots).

help._about: showTheWayAt: a dish wrong this many times is shown the right way. pastSupportFrom: an asked-for word the child's ladder has at this stage or above is past support: no stuck help comes for it, and Nani's line shows it as hintDots round dots (hintDotGap dots apart) until her helper card opens (old js/shared/onboard.js:518, a word supported to stage 2 of the old ladder, whose stage 3 is four right as this ladder's is; old js/cook/lang.js:201-222, the same dots whatever the word's length, so its length tells nothing).

words._about: holdMs: the least time a big card is held as its word is said, by how well the child knows the word, not by level (old chai's numbers and rule, old js/shared/rules.js:154-163; Zafar, 19 Nov): new; learning, from one right try; known, once its shelf pill is earned (js/shared/progress.js wordStage).

lines._about: The lines every mode says, as meanings for the language engine. no: Nani's "no" as a wrong thing is refused (Mum's na).

wordArt._about: A word's own picture, the same on the shelf, on its card and in the helper. closeup: the thing itself, close up and out of its jar, for the small round count pills above the stove (Zafar, 14 Nov: "an easy to see piece of ginger, garlic etc."). size: the shelf's size class (L, M, S).

art._about: The kit's own pictures, by art id.

timings._about: How long the page waits for what it needs. pictureWaitMs: the longest a scene, or a move showing a picture, waits for that picture before it goes on without it (old chai's cap on a station's load, js/cook/station-lib.js:755).

look._about: The look's numbers. vars: fed to the one style sheet (css/kit.css) as variables, so no size or colour is typed there. turn-disc: the turn-your-phone card's disc; start, start-phone: the first-tap play button on a laptop and on a phone. item-*: the order row's item card, a share of its row (cqi: of the row for its padding, of the card inside it), as the standard measured; tick: its corner mark; no-sign, no-inset: a "no" card's sign in its picture's top right corner, and how far in, as shares of the picture's width (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'in the upper right corner ... but bigger than the old version': old chai's is 17.2 px on a 64 px picture at his phone, old css/shared/order-card.css:599; 0.40 is 1.5 times it, his pick A of three: Zafar, 18 Nov, 'A is the correct one'); no-pic: the picture under it, nearly whole so the thing shows; eye-*: a hidden picture's eye, its width, height and icon, the one size on every card, the big card's grown by the screen's scale as the side panel is, so it is the row card's on the screen (Zafar, 19 Nov); helper-*: Nani's helper card; big-*: the big card's insides, as shares of its width; tap: a full tap; panel-fade: the order list's soft foot; speaker-min, speaker-phone: a speaker's least drawn size, and its share on a phone. end-ground: the plain ground under the end card's dim, so nothing of the round shows round the card (the standard's end). wordFont, wordWeight: the words drawn in the play area (the shelf's pills, a word's pop): drawn sharp, so a step heavier than the standard's 600, which its blurrier drawing showed this heavy (measured side by side, 18 Nov). gapStyle: a word the engine cannot build yet, drawn there as its English in the grey (vars.grey) and italic, as everywhere else (non-negotiable 1). solidAlpha: a pixel this opaque (of 255) is part of a picture's own outline (stage.solid). The order panel's vars: nani-* her box (two lines' room and a hairline, nani-hair, as the standard's, nani-font-lift her line's size as the panel shrinks), cards-* the list, head-* a card's top line, fold-* a card folding and its tick, helper-*-ms her helper sliding (helper-fade-ms: its card fading out early in the shut, and in as it opens), row-fade the row's edge fade; pop-* the big card's defaults; wm-* the word moment's card (shares of its width, old chai's measured at 1280x665 and 950x290: picture 56.25% tall, its art 6% in, the Kutchi 15% wide, the English 7.4% (never under item-en), the divider 74.8% wide, 1.5 px, and the speaker 25% (never under a tap) 7% either side, no ring: old css/shared/word-moment.css:66-76), its frame (corners closing in from 30% further out, their size kit.wordMoment.corner, a 2 px white line with a soft shade, rounded by kit.wordMoment.cornerRound, its flash fading over 420 ms: old word-moment.css:32-49); item-ku-top, item-en-top: the Kutchi under the picture's spare and the English under the Kutchi, old chai's card (Zafar, 6 Nov: old css/shared/order-card.css:680-681), the divider item-step under the English's ink (old js/shared/word-card.js fit14); big-gap: the big card's words' gaps (old css/shared/word-card.css:162, 2.4%); wm-ku-top, wm-en-top: the word moment card's (old css/shared/word-moment.css:73-74, 4% and 3.5%, the divider wm-gap under the English); speaker-pulse-*: a speaker lit while its word is said (old css/shared/word-card.css:124-125); count-* the count pills; tail-* the bubble's tail. badge-*: the speaker badge on a face, all of it a share of the face it is on, so it is the same on every face at every size (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'make it scale with the face it's on'): badge-of-face its size, 0.40, between old chai's 16 on a 48 face and the 0.46 he had on his phone (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'somewhere between the old and current size'; old css/shared/face.css:40 draws 0.38 with a 16 px floor); badge-x, badge-hang its place (left of the face's box as the standard's 2 px on a 44 px face, and just below it: less than the standard's 3 px, so it stays clear of the item cards below: Zafar, 18 Nov); badge-ring its outline, thinner than the standard's 2 px (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'maybe reducing the outline around it will help'); bubble-line: the bubble's edge. Shadows keep to the room round them: a box that clips (the order list, a row, a fold, Nani's helper) cuts a shadow only at a visible edge, the screen's, the side panel's or the play area's, so no corner shows a hard square (Zafar, 20 Nov: the order card's top corner); so card-shadow, item-shadow, helper-shadow, helper-spk-ring's drop and a lit speaker in the side panel (speaker-on-ring, speaker-on-color: old chai's steady ring round the order row's speaker, no pulse, its 4 px scaled with the panel and drawn inside the speaker's own tap room: old css/shared/order-card.css:267) reach no further than the panel's padding, a row's own padding and the helper's room at a phone's size, falling below their card rather than round it (check step 5 measures it).

halo._about: The gold halo behind a lit thing: its colour, how far it spreads (design px), how many copies make it soft and on which rings (shares of the spread), each copy's strength, and its breathing (to this alpha, this long each way).

speakerMark._about: The flat speaker on a pill, in design px from its left edge: the box, the cone, and its two waves.

textures._about: The sizes of pictures the stage makes itself, in px: a face badge, a soft shadow, a halo's small copy; the badge's hairline; dprMost: the canvas drawn at the screen's pixel ratio (the frame's), never more than this (a phone's 3 costs more than it shows); textSharp: the canvas's words drawn this many times the screen's pixels they cover (a little over, so never shrunk much: drawn 3 times their size, they were shrunk 5 times on a laptop and looked grainy, Zafar, 18 Nov: 'even the text'); solid: the small copy a picture's solid outline is read from; outline: the working copy a flat thing's own-shape shadow and dimming are drawn from.

boxShadow._about: The soft shadow of a flat thing on the worktop (the hob, the serving tray), in its own shape (its picture blurred), from the same light as the standing things' shadows: moved right and down by dx, dy and blurred by blur, all shares of the thing's shorter side; alpha: its strength; padOfBlur: the room kept round it for the blur, in blurs.

frame._about: How the page fits the screen it has, live (js/shared/frame.js). formFactors: by shape, not size: a phone's short side is under phone.shortBelow; a tablet or folding phone's is at least tablet.shortFrom and it is no wider than tablet.aspectUpTo; anything else is a laptop. scale: one number per screen, clamp(min, short side / refShort, max); it grows the side panel and the page's own buttons. side: the side panel's width, clamp(min x scale, share x width, max x scale). panel: the panel's own scale (--p) on each form factor. fit: while the panel's content would not fit, its scale steps down by step, never below minScale times its own. turnBelowWidth: an upright screen narrower than this gets the turn-your-phone card. settleMs: a turn is laid out again once it has settled. fonts, fontsWaitMs: the faces waited for before anything is drawn, at most this long.

voice._about: The family's voices, played through the page's sound (js/core/voice-player.js). gain: how loud, against the file. trim: the silence a recording left at either end is cut: the first and last sound are where the level passes floorShare of the clip's peak (never under floorMin), with leadS before and tailS after kept, and a clip whose sound is shorter than minS plays whole. endPadMs: a clip always ends by its length plus this, whatever the browser does. loadMs: a clip's download and decode give up after this long (it is tried again the next time). clockMs: how often a clip's own clock is looked at. wordGapMs: the pause between two words of a line said word by word, as old chai has it: old js/core/voice.js:472 waits 40 ms, then old js/cook/core.js:286-293 and :339-341 fetch and decode the next clip only when it is due, so its words came 0.44 to 0.62 s apart (measured end to start in old chai, level 1, 8 joins over 3 plays; mean 0.53 s). Mum's whole takes have no such pause.

device._about: The device's own voice, for a word with no family recording, on the test path only (js/core/voice.js deviceSpeak); every number old chai's (old js/core/voice.js:315-421). rate: its speed. cancelGapMs: after a cancel the browser drops a word spoken in the same breath, so the next waits this long (old :317). voicesWaitMs, voicesPollMs: a phone's Chrome loads its voices lazily; wait this long at most from the first ask, looking this often (old :343, :372). noStartMs, noVoiceMs: a word that has not started by then is let go of and cancelled (with voices, and with none installed: old :414, 900 ms; 1500 since Zafar, 21 Nov: on his phone the order's first word, "muke", read by the device before Mum's clips, started later than 900 ms and was dropped unheard; a late word still never plays out of turn). capMs + capPerLetterMs x its letters: the longest a word may speak (old :415). dueEveryMs: how often a word that speaks looks whether its line is still wanted (new: old chai had no late cancel).

cards._about: The order cards' timings, in milliseconds. foldAfterMs: a served card holds its ticks this long, then folds. peekMs: how long a tapped-open part stays open. kuLeast, enLeast: px; a word shrinks to fit its card no smaller than these, the Kutchi to two lines, the English to one, wrapping only below (old js/shared/word-card.js fit14: 11 and 10). dropShare: a letter's ink below its baseline counts as a tail past this share of its size (old dropOf14); fitSteps: the most px a word's lines are shrunk by, one at a time. dotsMin, dotsMax: a hidden word's dots, one fewer than its letters, between these; kuDotGap, enDotGap: the gap between two dots, in dots (the Kutchi's and the English's; their size is the style sheet's). lessonBeatMs, lessonEndMs: the first-time lesson's beat after each part and after the last; lessonCardMs: its light round the whole card first, then gliding to each part in lessonMoveMs; its light round each part's ink is every light's (the light block below: its margin and least room, even on all four sides; Zafar, 19 Nov), never a margin of its own; lessonMinPx: a part smaller than this is not asked for.

sounds._about: The sound effects, by name. files: recorded sounds (loop: played round and round; cut: only its first part, in ms; rise: a loop's playback rate from empty to full, below). synth: sounds made of notes, each [wave, from Hz, to Hz, ms, loudness, starts at ms]; noise: [ms, band Hz, sharpness, loudness, starts at ms]. under: how loud a sound the child made plays under a voice; tick: a short tick under a voice; master: the made sounds' overall loudness. stamp: the served moment, as a served card's tick pops (there is no stamp picture any more, Zafar, 19 Nov), old chai's thump and a warm low note after it (old js/shared/sfx.js chop, js/cook/flow.js stamp: chop, then soft 60 ms later). simmer: the boil's loudness in dB at heat 0, at the bubbling, and at boiling over. A loop's rise: its playback rate from the glass empty to full, by how full it is (sounds.rise; a half glass ends halfway): the old game's pour rose in pitch as the glass filled, its synthesised loop's ring from 380 to 1500 Hz over the pour (old js/shared/sfx.js:290-296, word-moment.js:430 pitch(0.2 + 0.8 x the time)); its recorded loop kept one pitch (old sfx.js:401-404). Here the recording itself rises, gently: about a semitone below its own pitch to a little over one above (0.94 to 1.08), so a glass is heard filling and the water still sounds like water (the lead's choice, Zafar, 18 Nov: 'if you have a rising pitch sound for the pour, then great, use it').

ramp._about: The sound player's own ramps, in seconds: floor: the quietest a fade reaches; attack, noiseAttack: a note's and a hiss's rise; tail: a note's stop after its end; loopFade, loopStop: a loop ending; duck, simmerDuck: how fast a loop goes under a voice.

move._about: The kit's one move (js/shared/kit/move.js): every place or size changing in front of the child glides in ms with this easing, never a cut or a cross-fade (Zafar, 21 Nov, the second time a snap reached him; the order scene's big card flying into its slot, the way he holds up, sets it).

order._about: The order's timings, in milliseconds. pop: a big card appearing; its flight into its slot is the kit's one move (move). partGap: between parts. cardOpen: a card opening. passAfter: before the next person. holdAlong: the beat after the last part. walkIn: people arriving, then walkWait before anyone speaks. dishCardOut: the dish's own card fading where it stands. bigW: the big card's widest, with its width's share of the play area's width (bigOfW) and height (bigWOfH); bigMaxOfH: never taller than this share of the play area's height (Zafar, 17 Nov, his red box), its width from the row card's shape (bigShape, height over width, if the row card cannot be measured). bigAt: the big card's corner beside the side panel. bigByPeople: the big card's place and size by how many people order. bigHeadGap: it never touches a head. bubbleGap: a bubble keeps this far off the big card. bubbleShift: the big card shrinks until the speaker's bubble need move aside by no more than this share of its own width. rowSlideMs, rowSlideEase: an order card's row, its cards sliding to their new places as one ticks (old js/shared/order-card.js:497); rowGlideAfterMs: then the row glides to its rest (old :534). focusPeek: a person's card brought into the panel's view shows at least this much of its top, the list scrolled no further. rowFadeRun: an order card's row fades at an edge while there is more to swipe that way, fully once this many px are left (its width: look.vars row-fade).

panel._about: The side panel's list of order cards (js/shared/kit/order-panel.js). It rests at its top or this many px above a card's top (edge, and at least edgeKeep px less than the gap between cards, so the card above is wholly out of view); it is measured once nothing in it has moved for quietMs and every card's fold and the helper's slide have ended (their times are look.vars fold-ms, helper-open-ms, helper-shut-ms), then glides there in glideMs. settleMs: its longest move, from a change to resting (a card's fold, quietMs, then the glide: check step 1 holds it at least those), which the kitchen's rules wait out before lighting a card. A big card waits for it at most stillCapMs before it flies.

room._about: The kitchen with its people, in design px. picture: where the tall painting's top-left sits. spots: where people stand, by x. counterY: the counter's back edge, which hides everything below it. lift: how much higher the order is framed, by how many people. from: where people walk in from. naniX: where Nani stands at the serve. serveGlide: how far the view glides down to the trays. tray: one serving tray per person and the dish landing on it. bubbleGap: the gap between a bubble and the top of the highest head's outline (its tail in that gap); talk: a speaker's talking picture flaps (open, then shut for a time between two numbers) with a small bob; at the thanks, afterMs: the beat a person rests in their happy pose, the bubble gone, before the next line. serveWait: the pause before the kitchen comes back. serveSpread: with three people they stand evenly from this far right of Nani to this far inside the right edge. tray.gapShare: a tray is at most this share of the gap between two people; tray.inside: kept this far inside the view; tray.shade: its shadow's width beside its own; tray.faceAt: the face mark's place on its rim; tray.keepBelow: the serve keeps this much below the trays' shadows in view. pictureH, pictureW: the painting's height and width (a room shown smaller to keep the serve's heads and trays whole never shows past its sides). needW: on a play area taller than the painting allows, the room is shown bigger, cropped at its sides, never narrower than this (everyone at the counter stays in view). speech: the speech strip every scene with people keeps above the highest head (Zafar, 18 Nov): one bubble's height, by kind (greet: the door's and the order's room, the tallest; line: the serve's) and form factor, in CSS px at the screen's scale, with bubbleGap below it and bubbleMin above; a bubble always sits in it over its speaker, and where the frame cannot give it the people stand lower. tailMin: the tail stays this far in from the bubble's ends, clear of its rounded corners, so no corner of it shows. sideKeep: screen px every head, and at the serve every tray, keeps inside the slice of the room the screen shows (people are spread across that slice).

wordMoment._about: The word moment's frame, shutter and card, sizes and times (ms) the old game's (old js/shared/word-moment.js, played at speed 0.75: old js/cook/ui.js:166, so each of its times is divided by 0.75 here). What shows each word is the family's act (the kitchen's pour: data/kitchen.json pourMoment). framePad: the snap's frame round the shown thing's own drawn box, the same on all four sides, a share of its height: the old frame's room at the glass's sides (0.232 of the glass, 19.7 px at his phone), now above and below too (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'more padding is better ... just increase the height of it to match the sides'); corner: its corners, a share of its shorter side (old css/shared/word-moment.css:36); One corner size for every frame in a moment (the smallest frame's). cornerCurve: their curve, px, the old frame's 16 px at every size (Zafar, 18 Nov: 'the slightly sharper corners are better': a share of the corner rounded the laptop's to 37 px), never more than cornerRound of a corner's size (16 px on his phone's 21.7 px corner). The word card's width is the act's (data/kitchen.json pourMoment cardOfGlass); shrunk at most cardFits times until it fits the room's height, never under cardLeast px (old :527-530); cardKeep: px it keeps inside the scene (old :531). cardGrowFrom, cardGrowMs, cardGrowEase: the card grows from the thing's size, from this opacity (old :534). lookMs: once shown, a look at all of them before the first snap (old :566-567: 450 and 900 at speed 0.75, less the kettle's going), halved (Zafar, 19 Nov: the wait from the last glass to the first photo, about 2 s to 1 s); cornersInMs: the corners start to close (old :480); cornersMs: the corners before the shutter (old :480-484, frameHold 500); shutterMs: the flash before the card (old :506); sayAfterMs: the card before its word (old :543); holdMs: after the word; lingerMs: the cards stay; fadeMs: the scene going (old js/cook/ui.js:172-174).

pictures._about: The plain act (js/shared/scenes/word-moment.pictures.js): a contrast shown by pictures alone, each side a word with its picture drawn count times at its scale (data/moments/). The old game had none, so it is laid out as the kitchen's pour lays out its glasses (data/kitchen.json pourMoment). lineAt: the line the pictures stand on, a share of the scene's height; tallest: a full-scale picture's most height, a share of it; top: the least room kept above, px; across: the share of its side's width a side may fill; apart: the room between pictures in a side, a share of their height; mostEach: the most pictures in a side. cardOf: a word card's width, a share of a full-scale picture's height (the pour's card is 1.25 of its glass: old word-moment.js:520), never wider than its side less cardRoom px. cardFill: in a word card's picture, a full-scale thing's height, a share of the picture's (the card shows its side as the scene did). inMs, inFrom: a side comes in, growing from this share of its size on its line; apartMs: the pause before the next side.

wrongOrder._about: The wrong-order pop-up (js/shared/kit/wrong-order.js; Zafar's design, 20 Nov, and his answers on its stills: the redesign spec in the fifth play's feedback), in ms, px and shares. One thing moves at a time, nothing shakes. veilIn: the veil over the whole screen coming down (and lifting), as the first-time light's dim fades in, while every served order's line leaves the panel for the stack in the middle (lift); veil: its strength, a share of the light's own dim (--dim): 1 is the light's own (Zafar, 20 Nov: 'use the onboarding light viel'); tick: the lines come out unticked (Zafar, 21 Nov), a right order's tick popping in with its ding and gold glow, before it flies off all the way up off the screen as it fades, by the kit's one move (Zafar, 21 Nov), its place kept; every move (the lines leaving the panel, the wrong line gliding to its card's top, the card opening down, narrowing as gaps close and going home) is the kit's one move (move: Zafar, 21 Nov); sayCap: the most a line holds the next. The card is then reviewed in one pass, left to right, every card in its turn (Zafar, 21 Nov: "fix the first card, fix the second card ... or like, confirm it's correct as it goes along"): lit, litRight: the card in its turn lit by the light's edge (nothing else dimmed: Zafar, 21 Nov, 'the strong outline does do a job') this long before its mark, a right card quick and a wrong one slow, a beat before it (Zafar, 21 Nov, yes to Fable's 3; beatRight, beat after each); stamp: its big mark, a gold tick or a maroon cross, stamp of the picture's width (vars.stamp), popping in; a right card's gold tick held as long as its own word is said and at least keep, near the cross's hold, so it is seen as plainly (Zafar, 21 Nov: 'I didn't see a ... big tick'; gold, the game's one colour for right: the panel's ticks, a right order's line), then going (stamp, the other way); a thing in a "no" order: after its cross, its card fades into the "no" card in stamp as the big no sign comes, held cross, then flying into the card's own corner sign by the kit's one move; cross: a wrong card's cross held before it falls; fall: a thing nobody asked for falling out of the card, fallBy its height; turn: a wrong amount turning over, the right amount on its back, half the time to its edge and half back, seen at a depth of turnDepth times the card's width (Zafar, 21 Nov: 'the card turns over', with no thickness: 'Just go to how it was before'); outline: the beat on a missing thing's dotted card before its card rises; rise: that card rising into it from riseBy its height below; beat: the pause after each card's turn; a thing nobody asked for stands last, and the cards slide together over its gap straight after it falls; hold: the last frame, before the card goes back by itself (a speaker's word starts it again; a tap on the veil skips to the last frame, a second ends it). flash: the wrong line's maroon flash, its tick a cross, with Nani's 'oho', before it opens; itemK: the lifted card's most growth, its item cards this many times the panel's; the stacked lines take the first wrong card's width and growth (Zafar, 20 Nov: nothing changes size as it opens); both stand in the room the family gives them (the kitchen's: the white marble, the play area above the bottom row: Zafar, 20 Nov), centred there, the card clear of the cog's place, edgeX, edgeY px clear of the room's sides and of its top and bottom, as big as fits; minText: the lifted card's Kutchi words never under this many px (the check measures it); english: every help is open on the lifted card, whatever the level (each picture whole, each word written: Zafar, 20 Nov, 'unblur everything for the pop up wrong card'), and with this its English is written out under each word as the panel's card writes it, without it there is none (English only ever supports the Kutchi and the pictures: Zafar, 20 Nov). vars: the style sheet's for the pop-up (as --wo-*); the lifted card is the panel's card grown by one zoom, with no sizes of its own (Zafar, 20 Nov: 'we should be using the exact same item cards and scaling'), but: dash, dash-w a missing thing's dotted card, its colour and width (stronger than the panel's, to be seen on the white card: Zafar, 20 Nov, 'E0 has a clearer outline'); line-gap the stacked lines' gap; flash-w the wrong line's maroon edge as it flashes; marks a line's tick or cross showing and its edge changing; glow the soft gold round a right order's line as it goes; extra the wider gap before the things nobody asked for, as times the row's gap; lit-w the light's edge round the card in its turn, drawn inside it; stamp the big tick, cross or no sign, a share of the picture's width (Zafar, 21 Nov: B, 45%, of three shown), the only marks on the card, none staying (Zafar, 21 Nov). face-grow: the person's face a little bigger while their card is up, bobbing while they speak as a person bobs in the room (room.talk bob and bobMs) (Zafar, 21 Nov, yes to Fable's 2).

greetings._about: The greeting's lines: each a meaning for the language engine, and the small picture that goes with an answer. by: who says the line, where it is not the person greeting ("child": an answer, the child's own line, said in the child's own form; the view and the check read it alike).

ladder._about: The word ladder: a word's stage climbs one for every so many rounds it was right first time on its weakest side (each filler it was met with: milk asked and not asked; grammar-in-play 8(a) 6), up to the top stage; from daysFrom up, only once every side was right first on this many different days (days; the table had no days, so the two-days condition is on the top stages only: 23 Nov). pillRun: a word picked right this many times running loses its written word on the shelf pill (a miss brings it back until the next right pick).

light._about: The light's box (js/shared/kit/light.js litBox, old chai's one rule: old js/shared/onboard.js:278-331): one margin on all four sides of the thing (a share of its smaller side, between two sizes in px: old's LIGHT, onboard.js:289), less on every side together where a neighbour that stays dark is nearer (Zafar, 19 Nov: all four sides equal), keeping clear px off it, and its corner. least: never less than this on any side, a share of the thing's smaller side between two sizes in px as the margin is, so about 4 px on the phone and 6 on the laptop, about half the margin (Zafar, 6 Nov: 'much too tight - the highlight box need some padding around the item'; 19 Nov: 'equal padding all around'): a light that hugs its thing breaks his rule as surely as an uneven one, so a neighbour nearer than that is let into the light's edge, which shows it lit, rather than squeeze the room; never more than the margin itself (a margin given for a thing is its own most). clear: 4, not old's 2: this light's gold edge is a 4 px stroke centred on the box's line, so 2 px of it lie outside the box; 4 keeps old's 2 px between the gold and the neighbour. overlap: a neighbour overlapping the thing by less than this share of its smaller side (at least min px) takes the margin to nothing, more is let be (old onboard.js:301-308). edgeIn: at the screen's edge the light stops this many px in (old onboard.js:1036-1040: 1 px, so 3 of the edge's 4 px still show). followMs: after anything on the page moves, the light follows its thing this long.

cog._about: The cog's menu, top right of the play area: its buttons, each with what it is for (a grown-ups' label) and its glyph; renews: the button that starts a new player. player: who is playing, shown beside the open menu for the grown-ups (Zafar, 19 Nov: 'the settings menu shows the player and has a New player button'), in the words the game and the labs page both use: label, then own (the child's own player), fresh (a new player), knows (a new player who knows the words).

greeting._about: The greeting's numbers. idleMs: with no answer for this long the person says it for the child. lightAfterWrongs: the right answer is lit after this many wrong tries. rightFirst: how often the right answer is the left one. afterClipMs: the answers rise this long after the line. wrongPauseMs: before the person asks again. afterReplyMs, fadeMs: the close. silentBase, silentPerLetter: how long a line with no recording is held. passGlyph: the pass button's mark.

end._about: The end screen's numbers. nearBest: a time within this many times the best keeps a dim gold watch. midShare: this share of rows right is the middle tier. shortSecs: under this a time shows as seconds and counts up. popMs: a tile's contents pop in. countSteps, countMs: the time counts up. waits: after each tile, in ms. tickSteps, tickMs, tickVolume: the rows count up, a tick on each. pageMs: the card eases to the second page. wordCols: word tiles across. tightOver, smallFrom: more words than this on a side sit tighter, then smaller. stars: where the six stars twinkle on a tile, each [left %, top %, delay s]. listKinds: the kinds of word the second page lists from a line (things and numbers; never a connective, a 'no' or a verb). listRows: the card's rows it lists, by their meaning's form (a thing's row, asked or not; never an amount's, whose word is no thing), read by both pages through one rule (js/shared/scenes/conversation.rules.js listedRows), so the tick tile counts exactly the rows the words page lists.

serving._about: The serving spot's small numbers (sizes in design px unless a share). face: a person's mark on the spot (its biggest, smallest, and size in screen px), kept this far from the spot's corner (pad), slid in at most (slide) to clear its dish by (clear). settle: a dish's small settle, as scales and times. undimMs: the spot coming out of its dim. drop: the painted drop (where it starts and lands and its width, in dish-widths; its fade and fall). twinkle: the three twinkles (small and big: their span and middle in dish-widths; each one's place and size in the span; the gap between them; grow from, turn, and times). review: the big faces (size with one dish; with more, between two sizes as a share of the gap between dishes; how far from the dish; kept inside the spot; pop from, pop time; a happy face's two small hops and a sad one's shake). praise: the white card by a face (gap, text inset, height, radius, lift, font, shadow, fade). closeMs, closeTo: the faces going. veil: the colour the tray is dimmed in while the cooking goes on (the game's dim says how much).

shelf._about: The bottom row's small numbers (design px unless a share). far: how far the band runs past the sheet's sides. band: its tile's scale and strength, the line along its top, the shelf tile's scale. fit: a thing is kept this much narrower than its slot. shade: a thing's shadow (lift, width as a share, height). pillPop: a tapped pill's pop. pillRadius, pillDrop: a pill's corner and its shadow's drop. squash: a thing taken or put back squashes and springs. spoon: the spoon (its start above the thing, its handle point, its angles at rest, over the pan and tipping; the last part of its stir, where it lifts and fades; its tip and going times). popRadius, popDrop: the word pop's corner and shadow.

lineTimes._about: Small waits round Nani's lines, in ms. wellDoneAfter: the praise comes this long after the faces pop; wellDoneCap: the longest it waits for her voice; wellDoneHold: the beat after it.
